{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the penguins dataset
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Verify that mean() automatically excludes NaN values
mean_with_na = penguins['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Manually exclude NaN values and compute mean to confirm
mean_manual = penguins['body_mass_g'].dropna().mean()

# Check if both methods give the same result
print(f"Mean with .mean(): {mean_with_na}")
print(f"Mean with .dropna().mean(): {mean_manual}")
print(f"Are they equal? {mean_with_na == mean_manual}")"}
